title: Non-Blocking Sync Send
goal: Attempt non-blocking sends on a bounded sync channel without deadlocking.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Bounded Channels

hints: Calling send on a zero-capacity channel without a receiver will block or return SendError.
try_send returns a TrySendError directly when the channel buffer is full without blocking.
explanation: `SyncSender::try_send` attempts to place a message in the channel buffer non-blocking, returning Err(`TrySendError::Full(val)`) if space is unavailable. `SyncSender::send` returns SendError<T>, which does not match the TrySendError return type. push is not a method on channel senders.
